Wrap option disabled preserves long lines without breaking

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"wrap\":false}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>This is a long paragraph that should not be wrapped at all because wrapping is disabled.</p>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
